title: Olivia Vruwink  CCC-SLP
text:
My name is Olivia Vruwink (pronounced ‘vroo-wink’). After working clinically as a speech-language pathologist for three years, I enrolled in a doctoral program in Speech-Language-Hearing Sciences at the University of Minnesota. I am studying various aspects of rehabilitation after traumatic brain injury, under the supervision of Dr. Natalie Covington. My research interests include purpose in life after traumatic brain injury (TBI) in patients and their care partners, with a focus on how it may contribute to overall well-being and rehabilitation outcomes. I am also interested in the scholarship of teaching and learning (SoTL) in the field of communication sciences and disorders. I am hoping to obtain a tenure-track faculty position with a mix of research and teaching/clinical responsibilities.
Welcome to my personal website. Many thanks to Samantha Csik for her spectacular tutorial on creating a personal website using Quarto.
